I replied in #coastal-team to Bettina. I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. My world tools can post and read, but they have no scheduler, and the Hermes cron tool only saves output locally, so it wouldn't post to Slack either.

I offered to post the 'Coastal week ahead' digest by hand whenever she asks, starting Monday 19 October if she wants that run. The weekly 08:00 schedule needs someone with access to a scheduler to set up.
